event.title: Ethiopian Drone Strikes Target Eritrean Forces Near Adigrat Amid Rising Tensions
event.canonical_title: Ethiopian Drone Strikes Target Eritrean Forces Near Adigrat Amid Rising Tensions
event.summary: Ethiopian drone strikes have targeted Eritrean forces near the city of Adigrat, resulting in damaged vehicles and reports of retreating troops. This escalation follows Ethiopia's expulsion of Eritrean diplomats and Eritrea's severance of diplomatic ties, raising concerns about a potential regional conflict.

timeline.title: Ukraine Targets Russian AI Infrastructure with Drone Strikes
timeline.summary: Ukraine has launched drone attacks aimed at Russian digital giant Yandex, disrupting its operations. The strikes are part of a broader campaign that includes ongoing assaults on missile plants and oil refineries. Yandex has acknowledged that customers may face service disruptions due to these attacks.
key_facts: Ukraine conducted drone attacks targeting Yandex.
The strikes are part of a broader campaign against Russian military infrastructure.
Yandex reported potential disruptions to its digital services.
